clusters.mechanism: Writing info/exclude in the new push repo fails under set -e when git init's template dir doesn't create info/ (custom or empty init.templateDir).
Fresh private index from read-tree has no stat data, and safe_git disables filter.* keys, so status re-hashes files and smudged LFS files appear modified, causing the land to be refused.
The checks:pager test runs without a TTY and doesn't assert --no-pager/GIT_PAGER, so it can't detect removal of pager isolation.
Inherited GIT_COMMON_DIR makes the test's late config injection hit the isolated repo rather than the clone, so the test doesn't exercise clone-config injection.
The no-private-strings test intermittently fails under load, with the land stopping before the push (cause unknown).
The source change exceeds the requested ~40-line size budget.
